description: Wire PRISM's quality chain (SPC, FAI AS9102, metrology) to hyperMILL output, build auto-generated setup sheet PDF for hyperMILL jobs, and register 20 hyperMILL-specific formulas in FormulaRegistry (F-HM-001 to F-HM-020). sessions.title: Quality Chain Wiring + Setup Sheet Generation
sessions.intent: Wire the existing quality engines to hyperMILL output and build auto-generated setup sheets. After this session, every hyperMILL job can produce a complete quality package (setup sheet, FAI plan, SPC control plan, measurement uncertainty budget).

units.title: Wire SPC + FAI + Metrology engines to hyperMILL job output
units.description: Create HyperMillQualityBridge that connects hyperMILL job output to: SPCProcessCapabilityEngine (Cp/Cpk targets per tolerance), FAIEngine (AS9102 first article inspection plan from drawing dimensions), MetrologyUncertaintyEngine (measurement uncertainty per feature type). Create cam:hypermill_quality_package action that generates complete quality documentation from a hyperMILL job.

exit_criteria: HyperMillQualityBridge connects to 3 quality engines
cam:hypermill_quality_package action generates quality documentation
SPC control plan with Cp/Cpk targets per tolerance
FAI plan in AS9102 format
Measurement uncertainty budget per feature
A quality inspector would accept the documentation format
4 unit tests: SPC plan, FAI plan, uncertainty budget, complete package

units.title: Build auto setup sheet generator for hyperMILL jobs
units.description: Wire SetupSheetEngine to hyperMILL jobs to auto-generate setup sheet PDF containing: machine assignment, WCS/datum locations, tool list with geometry, operation sequence with speeds/feeds, fixture description, safety notes, quality checkpoints. Include hyperMILL-specific fields: controller model, post-processor variant, AC script references, cycle type per operation.

sessions.title: Formula Registry — 20 hyperMILL Formulas (F-HM-001 to F-HM-020)
sessions.intent: Register 20 hyperMILL-specific formulas in FormulaRegistry. Agent 20 identified 14 formulas stranded in data catalogs — this session extracts them plus 6 additional formulas discovered during MS2-MS8 work. Each formula gets a proper F-HM-NNN identifier with source citation.

units.title: Register F-HM-001 to F-HM-010 — cutting parameter formulas
units.description: Register 10 cutting parameter formulas: F-HM-001 (hyperMILL MAXX roughing optimal stepover), F-HM-002 (scallop height from ball-nose tool diameter + stepover), F-HM-003 (effective cutting diameter at depth for ball-nose), F-HM-004 (trochoidal slot width from tool + engagement), F-HM-005 (pecking depth formula from L/D ratio), F-HM-006 (thread mill feed from pitch + tool diameter), F-HM-007 (barrel cutter effective radius), F-HM-008 (MAXX HPC chip thinning correction), F-HM-009 (5-axis tilt compensation for effective feed), F-HM-010 (rest material tool diameter selection). Each formula cites hyperMILL manual source.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 10 formulas registered as F-HM-001 through F-HM-010
Each formula has source citation (manual part + page)
Formulas compute correctly against known reference values
FormulaRegistry count increased by 10
5 unit tests: scallop height, effective diameter, chip thinning, tilt compensation, rest material

abort_criteria: formula results don't match reference values

units.title: Register F-HM-011 to F-HM-020 — process + quality formulas
units.description: Register 10 process/quality formulas: F-HM-011 (grinding specific energy from wheel + material), F-HM-012 (EDM material removal rate from current + voltage + gap), F-HM-013 (electrode wear ratio from material pair), F-HM-014 (heat treatment soak time from cross-section + material), F-HM-015 (turning CSS RPM at diameter), F-HM-016 (threading lead-in distance from pitch), F-HM-017 (surface roughness from feed + nose radius — turning), F-HM-018 (probing approach speed from trigger force + stylus mass), F-HM-019 (measurement uncertainty from probe + temperature + fixturing), F-HM-020 (cycle time from cut length + feed + rapid distance + accel). Each formula cites source.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 10 formulas registered as F-HM-011 through F-HM-020
Each formula has source citation

units.title: Build formula validation test suite + formula-to-engine cross-reference map
units.description: Create comprehensive test suite validating all 20 F-HM formulas against published reference values. Build cross-reference map showing which engine uses which formula (e.g., F-HM-002 used by HyperMillStrategyEngine for scallop height prediction, F-HM-015 used by hypermill-css-limit hook for RPM check). This map enables formula impact analysis when values change.
